assessments.name: Debate/Round Table Discussion
assessments.description:
Lead a formal debate or roundtable discussion on post-growth issues, including developing critical arguments and engaging with the views of others. Generative AI can be used to support research, but students must be able to defend ideas
without AI.

assessments.name: Presentation of an Existing Post-Growth Community
assessments.description: Present an existing post-growth community. Analyse its key characteristics, practices, and contributions to post-growth thought. Generative AI can be used to support research, but presentation is verbal and students must be able to defend ideas without AI

assessments.name: Post-Growth and Personal Reflection
assessments.description: Reflect on how post-growth concepts apply to your life. Discuss personal experiences related to sustainability, consumption, and well-being. Explore how these ideas influence everyday choices. Assessment is focused on personal reflection.
